article.headline: Wagner and the Magic take on conference foe Washington
article.description: Orlando Magic (7-10, eighth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Washington Wizards (7-12, ninth in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Wagner and the Magic take on conference foe Washington
article.linkText: Wagner and the Magic take on conference foe Washington
article.story: Orlando Magic (7-10, eighth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Washington Wizards (7-12, ninth in the Eastern Conference) Washington; Saturday, 5 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Washington takes on Orlando in a matchup of Eastern Conference teams. The Wizards have gone 7-9 against Eastern Conference teams. Washington is 3-11 against opponents with a winning record. The Magic have gone 5-7 against Eastern Conference opponents. Orlando ranks sixth in the Eastern Conference allowing only 112.4 points while holding opponents to 46.9% shooting. The Wizards average 110.6 points per game, 1.8 fewer points than the 112.4 the Magic give up. The Wizards average 107.4 points per game, 8.8 fewer points than the 116.2 the Wizards give up to opponents. The teams square off for the third time this season. The Wizards won 116-96 in the last matchup on Nov. 23. Kyshawn George led the Wizards with 24 points, and Tristan da Silva led the Magic with 18 points. TOP PERFORMERS: Anthony Davis is averaging 25.6 points and 10.1 rebounds for the Wizards. George is averaging 3.0 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. Franz Wagner is scoring 24.2 points per game and averaging 7.0 rebounds for the Magic. Desmond Bane is averaging 4.2 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Wizards: 3-7, averaging 109.9 points, 44.7 rebounds, 23.5 assists, 6.9 steals and 5.3 blocks per game while shooting 44.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 119.7 points per game. Magic: 5-5, averaging 108.6 points, 44.7 rebounds, 26.6 assists, 8.2 steals and 4.5 blocks per game while shooting 45.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 110.7 points. INJURIES: Wizards: Tristan Vukcevic: out (hip), Jamir Watkins: out for season (acl), Justin Champagnie: out (foot), Reece Beekman: out (shoulder). Magic: Paolo Banchero: out (ankle), Jonathan Isaac: out (knee), Izaiyah Nelson: out (ankle), Noah Penda: out (hamstring). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
